notes.title: Game Updated. (Nov 22th)
notes.content:
Greetings from CFK supporters.

CFK wants to thank deeply for all the fans have been paying high attention to WONDER BOY RETURNS and also could be in touch with WBR forum since its launch to begin with.

Accordingly with your opinions collected via Forum and mails, we just have made a makeover update in WBR and has prepared some extra entertaining features too. Let's call this reflection as Ver 1.0 from now on.

1. Changes in Title Menu, Functions add in Option Menu
2. Graphics renewal in Character, Lobby and Background
3. Game Balance tweaked to appropriate level and Number of 'Life' is adjusted up to difficulty level.
4. "Tina" is added as New Character insertion. "Classic Boy" in classic looks is added as well.
  
Mentioned hidden characters can come to be available only provided that following conditions are met in Game.

※ Condition to get 
   Classic Boy : Clear 'Stage 1-4' with Normal difficulty
   Tina : Get 30 Dolls regardless of Difficulty level

In case of any more problematic situations, we will do make continuous fix and improvements.

Thanks again for waiting long time, we will do try to respond well.

Best Regards
CFK
